posts.name: ProfileSpot
posts.tagline: Put your product directly in front of my X audience
posts.description: Put your SaaS, AI tool, or startup on NOVA's X bio for 7 days. 3.1M monthly impressions, 500K weekly profile views. Live within 24 hours of booking.

posts.name: WaterChamp: Hydration & Caffeine Tracker
posts.tagline: Know how your caffeine is metabolized with smart reminders.
posts.description: Hydration & caffeine tracker with multiple unique features. See your hydration and caffeine levels as a real-time graph. Know when you should drink, when the peak caffeine buzz hits or when it is metabolized so you can have a healthy good night sleep. The app also includes Blood Alcohol Content estimator so you know when the hangover should pass.

posts.name: Windy Gap
posts.tagline: Windy Gap generates hiking and running routes for you
posts.description: Windy Gap generates hiking and running routes based on what you ask for. There are potential routes all around us and it finds them. Ask for a route: distance, hills, terrain and more, and it searches the map for the best options.

posts.name: LexQ
posts.tagline: The Decision Operations Platform for engineering teams
posts.description: LexQ is a Decision Operations Platform for engineering teams. Define, test, and deploy business rules without touching application code — with built-in Impact Simulation and full audit trails.

posts.name: Snapplings: The Daily Object
posts.tagline: Everyone snaps one object. AI makes every one different.
posts.description: New: The Daily Object. Every day the whole game photographs the same everyday thing — a mug, a shoe, a spoon — and AI turns each photo into a different creature. They all go on one public wall, side by side. Everyone votes; at midnight the winner gets a crown on its card forever. Catch it daily to build a streak. Five days in, strangers show up every morning and a Common has already beaten a Legendary on one vote. Free, no sign-up, works in your browser and on iOS.

posts.name: 1acre.in
posts.tagline: India's first Verified land marketplace and intelligence
posts.description: Access 43,000+ verified lands, 300+ map layers, and tools to evaluate land across India. Call sellers directly.

posts.name: SquishyFile Video Upscaler
posts.tagline: AI + FSR video upscaler, no upload, no sign-up, free
posts.description: Stop uploading your videos to some random site just to make them less blurry. SquishyFile upscales any clip to 1080p or 4K right in your browser — no queue, no watermark, no sign-up. It automatically picks an AI model or FSR shaders depending on your source, so old recordings, downloads and screen captures come out sharp instead of pixelated. Free, forever.

posts.name: 1acre.in
posts.tagline: India's first Verified land marketplace and intelligence
posts.description: Access 43,000+ verified lands, 300+ map layers, and tools to evaluate land across India. Call sellers directly.

posts.name: Code Tracker AI
posts.tagline: AI-powered code intelligence for JetBrains IDEs
posts.description: Code Tracker AI brings real-time code intelligence, explainability, and developer clarity directly into JetBrains IDEs. It analyzes your code, flags issues, explains root causes, and preserves your reasoning with automatic Code Books. Unlike traditional linters, CTAI teaches while it fixes — helping developers ship faster, onboard quicker, and maintain long-term project clarity.

posts.name: Six Axes
posts.tagline: Your table already tells the story. This writes it down.
posts.description: Six Axes is a session-analytics tool and toolkit for tabletop RPGs. It records your game, transcribes it, and turns it into a recap, an automated campaign wiki, and a record of what was actually rolled at the table, plus player-engagement analytics across six axes of play. It works with D&D 5e, Pathfinder 2e, Draw Steel, and Daggerheart, with more systems on the way. Free while in pilot.

posts.name: MotiTune
posts.tagline: Your Intrinsic Motivation
posts.description: Do you know what your motivation for work is? I bet you don't. Or not really that well. Probably fuzzy. If you want to increase your self-awareness, understand yourself better, and make better decisions try out our Intrinsic Motivation assessment. Self-serve. It's not your personality, rather this is what you value at work, this is what motivates you. Everyone is unique, as it is based on our own life experiences. It is 55 questions, takes about 10 minutes, and you'll get your motivation report.

posts.name: MetriQ AI
posts.tagline: One workspace. Every AI. Shared memory.
posts.description: Connect every AI model into one workspace. MetriQ keeps your conversations, files, and knowledge connected with shared memory.

posts.name: PulseGuard
posts.tagline: Autonomous Site Reliability Engineering Platform
posts.description: PulseGuard is a self-hosted, multi-tenant incident response platform. It acts as an automated SRE console that ingests raw telemetry logs, clusters related errors, consults organizational runbooks via semantic vector search, and deploys sandboxed AI agents to diagnose production outages and submit Pull Request hotfixes.

posts.name: Pickfrompic
posts.tagline: Pick colors from images, create palettes, generate gradients
posts.description: Pickfrompic is a free, open-source color tool for designers and developers. Upload any image and extract dominant colors instantly, pick pixels with precision, build custom palettes, generate CSS gradients, and convert between 8 color formats - HEX, RGB, HSL, HSB, CMYK, LAB, LUV, and HWB. Everything runs entirely in your browser with zero data sent to any server. No account needed.

posts.name: TV - Family Calendar
posts.tagline: Apple TV Calendar
posts.description: Turn your Apple TV into a beautiful shared calendar. Sync iCloud and Google Calendar, keep everyone on schedule, and enjoy the complete app with no subscription.

posts.name: ProUI
posts.tagline: Building toolkit for professional software
posts.description: If you're building Serious Software™ - ProUI is *the* toolkit for you. ProUI is a precision-engineered collection of shadcn/ui components for crafting beautiful, information-dense and native-feeling UIs for professional applications. Inject my half a decade of experience of building pro apps straight into your coding agent. Whether you're building an image editor, a video NLE, a DAW or a Three.js game engine with Astra - ProUI makes it look and feel like the real deal. Includes 6 app templates.

posts.name: Tokenflow
posts.tagline: See where your AI spend actually goes
posts.description: Your AI coding agents bill you monthly and tell you nothing. TokenFlow reads the logs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Cline write on your machine, prices every branch, and posts the cost on the pull request as a comment plus a status check — so a change over its declared budget fails before it merges. A guard hook brakes a session while it is still running, and an MCP server hands the same numbers to the agent spending the money. Local-first, zero dependencies, MIT. Nothing leaves your machine.

posts.name: Meld.
posts.tagline: A private memory that answers from what you save
posts.description: Meld turns notes, links, PDFs, images, audio, supported files, and public YouTube links into organized, connected knowledge. Ask a question later and get an answer grounded in your own saved sources so you remember the idea, not where you saved it.

posts.name: Mengram 2.47
posts.tagline: Memory that survives /clear, compaction and the next agent
posts.description: Seven months after the first launch, this one is about the work, not memory types. Hooks for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: recall on every prompt, save after each turn, a checkpoint before compaction that puts the working state back. New: `mengram resume`, a task card (done, remaining, last test and its commit) the next session or agent picks up, keyed by repo and branch. Every fact says which tool wrote it and when. Benchmark: 23-62x fewer context tokens than sending history, losses published.

posts.name: TabMail 1.8
posts.tagline: Now open source. AI email for Thunderbird and iPhone.
posts.description: TabMail 1.8 is now open source, with better UX and improved AI quality. Auto replies, email triage, conversational editing, and chat with your inbox. On Thunderbird or iPhone. Supercharge your existing inbox with AI.

posts.name: Chasr
posts.tagline: Put your goals on the internet. Make them harder to ignore.
posts.description: Most goals are made in private and forgotten a few weeks later. Chasr lets you put your goals in public. Set a target, add a deadline, share your page, and update your progress as you go. It's built around one simple idea: goals are harder to abandon when other people can see them. Free, open source, and built for anyone chasing something.

posts.name: balibestplaces
posts.tagline: Independent, curated guides to the best of Bali
posts.description: Bali Best Places is an independent travel guide and directory covering the whole island. Hotels, restaurants, bars, dive shops, spas... organized by location and interest Every place is rated using a transparent scoring system, editorial content is written independently (no pay-for-placement), and locals/business owners can also add their own spots. Built for travelers who are tired of recycled listicles and want a real, current picture of what's actually good in Bali right now.

posts.name: POI Data for AI Agents
posts.tagline: POI data to power smarter, location-aware AI agents.
posts.description: Access high-quality POI data for AI agents, maps, search, recommendations, and location intelligence. Explore ready-to-use datasets covering businesses, places, categories, addresses, and more.

posts.name: GetFullPage
posts.tagline: Screenshot any page in Chrome with 1 click. Free.
posts.description: Free Chrome extension. Capture any webpage as a full-length screenshot or PDF. 100% local — no account, no server, nothing uploaded.

posts.name: Hypertradeworx
posts.tagline: One order ticket for Hyperliquid, Lighter, GMX and Ostium
posts.description: Pre-IPO perps on Anthropic and OpenAI, plus stocks, gold, FX and crypto, all routed across Hyperliquid, Lighter, AsterDex, Ostium and GMX from one order ticket and one self-custodial wallet, so you never move funds between five separate frontends. Up or Down markets settle on 5 and 15 minute Chainlink windows. A built-in AI agent drafts orders in plain language and never executes anything without your confirmation. Practice with $1,000 before you deposit.

posts.name: Kepos
posts.tagline: Shared memory for teams and their AI agents
posts.description: Most AI memory tools give one agent recall. Most team wikis give humans a shared doc. Kepos does both: multiple AI agents and humans read/write the same memory in real time, with git-backed version history — nothing silently overwritten — and self-enforcing learnings, where a correction recorded once gets automatically blocked from recurring. Memory that behaves like code, not a mutable blob.

posts.name: AI Economics Field Guides
posts.tagline: Practical worksheets for AI costs, limits, and pricing
posts.description: Two free workbooks for teams building with AI. Survive the Launch helps founders model cost per useful task, launch spikes, free-tier exposure, heavy users, and agent budgets. Add AI. Keep Your Margins. helps established teams protect plan margins, design included usage, choose a value unit, and set pricing triggers. Each guide has 10 five-minute exercises and a readiness card. No signup. No catch. Just practical lessons learned the hard way.
